r1.text:
WHO CAN DO WHAT
Admin: create a set for the whole school or any classes; add, rename or switch off the school's own exam types; remove an exam with no marks; change a subject's teacher.
Class head: create a set for their own class only (class chips locked to theirs); remove exams in their class with no marks.
Subject teacher: no access to Exam sets; their new exams appear in Marks > To mark.

RULES
Classes are the default unit. A class is expanded only to pick a single stream.
No streams: the expand arrow is hidden. Streams can have any names.
An exam with marks shows a lock in place of Remove.
Secondary schools: chips group by S1 to S6 (or Form 1 to 6); nothing else changes.

r2.text:
WHO CAN DO WHAT
Subject teacher: sees only exams for their subject and streams; enters marks, saves, submits; fixes and resubmits a returned subject.
Class head: sees the whole class (every stream, every subject); can enter marks for any subject in their class.
Admin: can open any grid read-only from Marks, and edit only after returning it.

RULES
Save keeps a draft only the teacher sees. Submit sends the subject for approval and locks it.
A returned subject unlocks and shows the reason at the top of the grid.
No streams: the Stream column and filter are hidden.
Marks are out of the exam's maximum (default 100). Blank = not yet entered; AB = absent.

r3.text:
WHO CAN DO WHAT
Admin: approves or returns any submitted subject; releases any class.
Class head: approves or returns subjects in their class; releases their own class.
Subject teacher: none of these screens.

RULES
Approved is not released: parents and students see nothing until Marks Release.
Releasing a sitting a second time needs a written reason, stored with the release and shown in the release history.
Positions are "of N" within the class (all streams); the stream position shows on hover and in the PDF.
No streams: the Stream column and stream filter disappear.

r4.text:
WHO CAN DO WHAT
Admin: any class; download one card or the whole class as one PDF.
Class head: their class only.
Teachers, parents, students: parents and students get only released results (see dashboards, batch 2).

RULES
Cards draw only on released marks. A class with unreleased marks shows "Not released yet" with a link to Marks Release.
The card layout follows the class level: nursery, primary, O level, A level. The school chooses which exam types appear (default: those that count towards the report).

r5.text:
WHO CAN DO WHAT
Admin: all tabs and all actions.
Class head: all tabs for students in their class; can add marks and record attendance; fees are read-only.
Accountant (if the school has one): Fees tab and Record payment only.

RULES
Overview is the default tab. Performance lists only released exams for download; the current progress report is built from approved marks and labelled "Progress report, not released".
Record payment goes against the student's total for the term; no splitting by fee item by default.

r6.text:
WHO CAN DO WHAT
Admin and accountant: edit the fee structure, record payments, mark paid, send reminders.
Class head: sees balances for their class, can send reminders; cannot record payments.

RULES
Duration: one-off, termly (default) or yearly. Totals per class are for one term: yearly fees count in Term 1 only, one-off fees in the term they're charged.
A payment goes against the student's term total; no splitting across fee items by default.
Amounts use the school's currency, set from its country (UGX here). Format with the currency code and thousands separators.
Reminders go on WhatsApp to linked parents; KlassApp never messages first, so reminders use the school's approved template.

r7.text:
WHO CAN DO WHAT
Admin: all classes; assign or invite a class teacher; open any class page.
Teacher: sees only their classes ("My classes").

RULES
Cards follow level order: Baby, Middle, Top Class, then Primary One to Seven.
The class filter is a dropdown, never a text box.
Assigning picks from existing teachers. Inviting sends an email setup link (no password). A stream class teacher is optional; schools with one teacher per class set it at class level.

r8.text:
WHAT THE TEACHER SEES
Only their own classes, students and exams.
Charts are for the class they head; a teacher with no class sees their subjects' performance instead of the class charts.
Quick actions: Take attendance, Enter marks.
"Marks needing attention" lists returned subjects first, then unfinished ones closest to their deadline.

r9.text:
RULES
Only released results appear anywhere for parents and students. An approved but unreleased exam is invisible to them.
Parents with several children pick the child at the top; the child's name appears once, there.
Students see the same cards for themselves, with no child picker.
Each card opens one simple page with one chart: performance across released exams, attendance by week, fees paid against what's due.
Attendance updates to parents are weekly (summary plus absences).

r10.text:
ADDITIONS ONLY
The rest of the admin dashboard is unchanged from the current build.
Students by gender: per class, and per stream when a class has streams; a toggle switches class and stream view. Classes without streams show one bar.
"What's set up" is a checklist: done items link to where they live, open items carry the one action that finishes them. It hides itself once everything is done and can be reopened from Settings.

m1.text:
MOBILE RULES (every screen)
Below 768px the sidebar and top bar give way to the phone top bar (avatar top right opens the account menu). Content goes edge to edge with 16px sides.
Tables: wide ones scroll inside their own box, never the page; lists become stacked cards (see Mark sheet).
Filters: one Filters button opens a bottom sheet (see Filters board on page 3).
Primary actions sit in a sticky bottom bar within thumb reach. Every target is at least 44px; main actions 48 to 52px.
Marks grid: below 768px only Student and Mark show, marks inputs grow to 52px, Save draft and Submit fill the bottom bar.
